stem:
Quadrilateral \(KLMN\) is similar to quadrilateral \(PQRT\). Some of the side lengths for the quadrilaterals are shown in centimeters.

What is the value of \(x\) in centimeters?
visual_elements: Two quadrilaterals labeled KLMN and PQRT with side lengths. Quadrilateral KLMN has sides 36 cm, 126 cm, 90 cm, and x. Quadrilateral PQRT has sides 4 cm, 14 cm, 10 cm, and 7 cm. A box states 'Not drawn to scale'.
